documents.title: Intimation For Product Development Pursuant To Regulation 30 SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Board Meeting Outcome for OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETING

Board Meeting Intimation for To Consider And Approve The Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 And To Consider The Recommendation Of Dividend, If Any
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Resignation of Company Secretary / Compliance Officer

analysis.summary: Management reported robust demand and increasing order inputs for high voltage and low voltage products in both domestic and global markets during Q3 FY24, contributing to sales growth. Total income reached Rs. 1079 million with an EBITDA of Rs. 82 million and PAT of Rs. 41 million.

guidance.claim: Management expects business momentum to persist driven by customer engagement and ongoing improvements in cost and quality.
guidance.quote: We expect the said momentum to continue in foreseeable future led by our continuous engagement efforts backed by continuous improvement in cost and quality improvement.

guidance.claim: Modison expects its plan execution capability and financial position to support long-term growth and success.
guidance.quote: We expect that our ability to effectively execute our plans and our robust financial position will lead to increased success and growth in the long run.

guidance.claim: Management expects that execution excellence and a strong balance sheet will enable the company to scale greater heights over the long term.
guidance.quote: We expect our execution excellence combined with a strong balance sheet will enable us to scale greater heights over the long term.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing robust demand for high voltage and low voltage products in both domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing robust demand of our product (High voltage and Low Voltage) in Domestic and Global market as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing acceptance from domestic and international customers led to a 21% increase in topline for Q2 FY24.
demand_outlook.quote: We saw increasing acceptance from Indian and global customers for our products leading to our topline increasing by 21% in Q2FY24.

demand_outlook.claim: Modison strengthened its high voltage leadership position as volumes registered a marked increase.
demand_outlook.quote: Our leadership position in HV business was fortified with volumes seeing a marked increase.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is observing early signs of customers wanting to shift from China to India as an alternate supply source.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing early signs of our customers wanting to shift from China to India as an alternate supply source.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted increasing acceptance of Modison as a well-regarded silver contact manufacturer.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing increasing acceptance of Modison as a well regarded silver contact manufacturer.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased to 8% in Q3 FY24 compared to -1% in Q3 FY23.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is increased to 8% during the Q3FY24 as compare to -1% in Q3FY23 and PAT margin is increased to 4% during the Q3FY24 as compare to -3% in Q3FY23

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY24 increased to Rs. 97 Mn compared to Rs. 25 Mn in Q2 FY23.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was Rs. 97 Mn as compared to Rs. 25 Mn in Q2 FY23

margins_costs.claim: The company applies Lean Six Sigma and execution excellence to reduce waste and production variances while improving performance.
margins_costs.quote: Lean Six Sigma and Execution excellence for Performance Improvement, Waste Removal & Production Variance Reduction

margins_costs.claim: Margins improved due to a focus on cost and quality.
margins_costs.quote: Our margins improved on account of cost and quality focus.

margins_costs.claim: The company continues to place emphasis on cost savings and inventory reduction.
margins_costs.quote: We continue to place emphasis on cost savings, inventory reduction and are fully focused on quality improvement.

orders_capacity.claim: The company witnessed increasing order inputs from domestic and global customers in HV and LV products, driving sales growth in Q3 FY24.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company saw increasing order inputs from the Domestic and global customer in HV and LV products, which results into growth of sales of the Company during the Q3FY24.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Our Board approved interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24 thereby maintaining our track record of uninterrupted dividend payouts for past 20 years signifying our healthy cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Low financial leverage has allowed Modison to deliver consistent dividend payouts for over 20 years.
capital_allocation.quote: Low financial leverage ensures excess return to shareholders in the form of consistent dividend payouts for 20+ years

capital_allocation.claim: There is zero promoter share pledge in the company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Key business risks flagged by management include strategy implementation, regulatory approvals, market exposures, and technological changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include but are not limited to our ability to successfully implement our strategy, our growth and expansion plans, obtain regulatory approvals, our provisioning palicies, technological changes, investment and business income, cash flow projections, our exposure to market risks as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: The topline was flat due to silver price variations.
risks_headwinds.quote: We saw flat topline due to silver price variations.

management_commitments.claim: The board approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24.
management_commitments.quote: Our Board approved interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24 thereby maintaining our track record of uninterrupted dividend payouts for past 20 years signifying our healthy cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects performance momentum to continue into the foreseeable future led by ongoing cost and quality improvement efforts.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the said momentum to continue in foreseeable future led by our continuous engagement efforts backed by continuous improvement in cost and quality improvement.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that it continues to place emphasis on cost savings and inventory reduction while remaining fully focused on quality improvement.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to place emphasis on cost savings, inventory reduction and are fully focused on quality improvement.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
